package.description: Provider switcher and local routing gateway for AI coding assistants.

en-US.description: Provider switcher and local routing gateway for AI coding assistants.
en-US.longDescription:
APISwitch is a lightweight desktop management tool and local protocol routing gateway for third-party API providers and Google Antigravity official subscriptions. It manages provider configurations for Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, OpenCode, and Pi, switches Google accounts with credential snapshots, tracks quota usage, and bridges OpenAI/Anthropic protocols through a local gateway with hot reload.

✨ Key Features
1. Unified Multi-Tool Management & Zero-Intrusion Switching
- Antigravity Quick Account Switching: Save credential snapshots and switch Google accounts with one click. Automatically captures and synchronizes the latest credentials before switching (preventing Refresh Token rotation expiration). Optionally auto-closes and smoothly restarts the IDE.
- Cross-Client Provider Sharing: One-click copy of provider configurations across Claude CLI, Claude Desktop, Codex, OpenCode, and Pi with intelligent field mapping (Auth Token ↔ Bearer Token / API Key). Enter once, use everywhere.
- Model Pool Management: Dedicated model pool mechanism for OpenCode and Pi, clearly distinguishing "In Config" from "Not in Config" states, supporting on-demand activation and batch maintenance.
- One-Click cc-switch Migration: Built-in migration wizard directly reads ~/.cc-switch/cc-switch.db, allowing checkbox selection to import existing providers with automatic deduplication and overwriting.
2. Built-in Local Protocol Routing Gateway
- High-Performance Local Gateway: Built-in lightweight HTTP gateway service (listening on 127.0.0.1:15725 by default, configurable Host and Port in settings, supports LAN sharing).
- Seamless Multi-Protocol Bridging:
  - Codex Protocol Bridge: Translates standard OpenAI Chat Completions / Anthropic endpoints into Codex native Responses protocol.
  - Claude CLI Protocol Bridge: Automatically manages authentication headers and request format mapping.
  - Claude Desktop Model Mapping: Intercepts and rewrites claude-sonnet / opus / haiku requests to your designated upstream custom models.
- Long-Context Protection & Prompt Stripping: Automatically strips non-essential excessive system prompts and provides safeguards against massive 1M context overflows to prevent upstream 400 errors or unexpected costs.
- Zero-Restart Hot Reload: Point your client to the local gateway once. Provider switches reload instantly in the gateway with no client restarts needed.
3. Data Backup & Multi-Device Roaming
- One-Click Full Export: Bundle all tool provider configurations and Antigravity account data into a standardized JSON backup file.
- Flexible Restore Modes: Supports both "Merge & Append" (recommended: keeps existing configs while adding new or updating matching items) and "Full Overwrite" modes for seamless roaming across multiple machines.
- Direct Local Management: One click to open the local physical storage directory for full data ownership and transparency.

🔬 How It Works
- Google Antigravity: Login sessions are stored in VS Code's globalStorage SQLite database (ItemTable) under antigravityUnifiedStateSync.oauthToken and userStatus (base64-encoded Protobuf). APISwitch includes a lightweight Protobuf parser to safely extract email, subscription tier, and quota information. Account switching executes safe transactional writes with automatic .backup creation.
- Claude Code CLI: Precisely rewrites ANTHROPIC_* environment variables in ~/.claude/settings.json, strictly preserving all other configuration sections such as hooks and permissions.
- Claude Desktop: Manages Cowork inference gateway parameters (inferenceProvider, inferenceGatewayBaseUrl, inferenceGatewayApiKey, etc.). Switching back to "Official" cleanly removes these fields to restore native official login.
- OpenAI Codex: Configures model_provider and [model_providers.<id>] in ~/.codex/config.toml, synchronizing authentication with auth.json. Supports direct upstream connections or routing through the local gateway for protocol adaptation.
- OpenCode & Pi: Strictly adheres to their official specifications to read and write opencode.json and models.json / auth.json, ensuring immediate recognition by CLI and runtime environments.
- Safe Atomic Writes: All file modifications follow a "write temporary file → verify integrity → atomic replace" workflow, generating automatic .bak backups to prevent corruption from unexpected interruptions.
en-US.name: APISwitch
en-US.releaseNotes:
[Key Feature · Gemini 4 (Argon) Independent Quota & Limit Monitoring]
- Account cards overhauled with a Triple-Column Quota Panel (Gemini models, Gemini 4 Argon, and Claude & GPT models).
- Direct integration with Google Cloud Code quota endpoint (retrieveUserQuotaSummary) to extract and monitor the argon quota bucket:
- Gemini 4 Dedicated 5-Hour Dynamic Limit (5H): Displays remaining quota percentage, high-precision progress bar, and reset countdown.
- Gemini 4 Dedicated Weekly Base Quota: Real-time weekly pool status, consumption progress, and reset cycle.
  • Subscription Tier & Quota Entitlement Awareness:
- Distinguishes official Paid Subscriptions ("PRO") from Promotional / Trial Quotas ("EXP").
- Paid subscription accounts unlock the full, dedicated Gemini 4 Argon quota pool;
- Promotional and trial accounts display "Shared with Gemini" or "No separate quota" with comprehensive hover tooltips explaining entitlements.
  • Historical Quota Snapshot Tracking: Quota snapshot service records historical gemini-argon-5h and gemini-argon-weekly fluctuations over time.
[New · Expanded Client Usage Monitoring (Gemini CLI / StepCode / zcode / dsh)]
- Added Gemini CLI local session scanning and ingestion (automatically parses %TEMP%\gemini_chat_*.json with high-performance transactional bulk insertion for millions of tokens).
- Added StepCode local session scanning, correcting token measurement criteria to precisely reflect true input/output token consumption.
- Added zcode and dsh agent usage monitoring; resolved dsh timestamp millisecond alignment and chronological order issues.
- Extended session scanning and SQLite retention window from 90 days to 400 days (over 1 year of full historical coverage).
[New · Long-Range Quick Ranges & GitHub / Claude-Style Heatmap Grid]
- Added "6 Months" (180 days) and "1 Year" (365 days) quick range selection buttons.
- Introduced GitHub / Claude-style Contribution Heatmap Grid:
- 7 rows (Monday to Sunday) across weeks, adapting dynamically to window resizing.
- Aligned month labels along the top and "Mon / Wed / Fri" weekday indicators on the left.
- Logarithmic 5-tier indigo intensity coloring to prevent single high-volume spikes from washing out regular daily activity.
- Hover tooltip displaying date, weekday, total tokens, and input/output breakdown.
- Interactive drill-down: click any cell to filter the entire window (summary cards, providers, clients, models, and recent calls) to that day; click again to deselect.
  • Adaptive chart mode: automatically defaults to Bar Chart for short ranges (\(\le 31\) days) and Heatmap Grid for long ranges (\(> 31\) days), with manual toggle buttons in the top-right header and dynamic legends.
[New · In-App Multilingual Update Dialog & Language Switching]
- Update dialog (UpdateDialog) automatically matches and renders release notes in the user's active application language (zh-CN / en-US).
- Added interactive [中文] / [English] language switch pills in the Changelog header for instant cross-language inspection.
- Offline bilingual fallback to local release notes when remote notes are omitted.
[Architecture & Engineering]
- Modularized usage scanning: introduced the IUsageSource interface and UsageSourceRegistry for clean multi-client expansion.
- Standardized Release outputs and removed unnecessary Debug caches.

zh-CN.description: 面向 AI 编程助手的第三方服务商切换与本地路由网关工具。
zh-CN.longDescription:
APISwitch 是一款轻量级桌面管理与本地协议路由网关工具，面向第三方 API 服务商与 Google Antigravity 官方订阅。支持管理 Google Antigravity、Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Codex、OpenCode、Pi 的服务商配置，一键切换 Google 账号并保存凭据快照，跟踪配额用量，并通过本地网关实现 OpenAI/Anthropic 协议桥接与热切换。

✨ 核心特性
1. 多工具统一管理与零侵入切换
- Antigravity 账号快捷切换：凭证快照存档，一键切换 Google 账号；切换前自动捕获并同步当前账号最新凭证（防 Refresh Token 轮换失效）；支持切换后自动关闭并平滑重启 IDE。
- 跨端供应商智能互通：支持在 Claude CLI、Claude Desktop、Codex、OpenCode、Pi 之间一键互相复制供应商配置，智能完成字段自动映射（Auth Token ↔ Bearer Token / API Key），一次录入，全端复用。
- 模型配置池化管理：针对 OpenCode 与 Pi 提供模型配置池机制，清晰标记「已加入配置 / 未加入配置」状态，支持按需激活与批量维护。
- 历史数据一键迁移：内置 cc-switch 数据库迁移向导，直接读取 ~/.cc-switch/cc-switch.db，支持勾选式导入已有供应商，自动去重与覆盖更新。
2. 内置本地协议路由网关（Local Protocol Router）
- 高性能本地代理：内置轻量级 HTTP 网关服务（默认监听 127.0.0.1:15725，支持在设置中自定义监听主机地址与端口，支持局域网多设备共享）。
- 多协议无缝转译：
  - Codex 协议桥接：将第三方 Chat Completions / Anthropic 端点智能转译为 Codex 原生 Responses 协议；
  - Claude CLI 协议桥接：自动处理鉴权 Header 与请求结构映射；
  - Claude Desktop 模型映射：拦截并重写 claude-sonnet / opus / haiku 等请求至目标第三方大模型。
- 长文本防护与上下文优化：自动剥离非必要超长 system prompts，提供巨量上下文截断防护，防止第三方端点报 400 错误或费用异常溢出。
- 零重启热切生效：客户端只需一次配置指向本地网关，切换供应商时网关即时热重载，无需反复重启客户端。
3. 数据备份与多设备漫游
- 一键全量导出：将所有工具的供应商配置与 Antigravity 账号数据一键打包导出为标准 JSON 备份文件。
- 灵活导入恢复：支持「合并追加」（推荐：保留已有配置，追加新供应商或更新同名项）与「完全覆盖」双模式导入，方便在多台开发机之间无缝漫游。
- 便捷本地管理：设置中支持一键打开本地物理存储目录，数据完全透明自主可控。

🔬 工作原理
- Google Antigravity：登录态存储在 VS Code 架构的 globalStorage SQLite 数据库（ItemTable）中，核心字段为 antigravityUnifiedStateSync.oauthToken 和 userStatus（base64 编码的 Protobuf）。APISwitch 内置轻量 Protobuf 解码器，安全解析邮箱、订阅计划与配额信息；切换时执行安全事务写入，并自动维护 .backup 文件。
- Claude Code CLI：精准修改 ~/.claude/settings.json 中 env 的 ANTHROPIC_* 相关环境变量，对于 hooks、permissions 等其他系统及业务配置严格原样保留。
- Claude Desktop：针对桌面客户端的 Cowork 推理网关参数（inferenceProvider、inferenceGatewayBaseUrl、inferenceGatewayApiKey 等）进行配置写入与维护；切换回「官方」档位时干净移除网关参数，无缝恢复官方原生登录。
- OpenAI Codex：配置 ~/.codex/config.toml 中的 model_provider 与 [model_providers.<id>] 节点，同时联动 auth.json 鉴权信息。支持直接连接第三方端点或经由本地网关进行协议适配。
- OpenCode & Pi：严格遵循各自官方规范读写 opencode.json 以及 models.json / auth.json，确保配置变更立即可被命令行或运行环境加载。
- 安全原子写入：所有涉及物理文件的写操作均执行「写入临时文件 → 校验完整性 → 原子替换」流程，并在写前自动生成 .bak 备份文件，杜绝因进程意外中断导致配置损坏。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
【重磅新增 · 支持 Gemini 4 (Argon) 独立配额与限额查看】
- 首页账号卡片全面重构升级为「三栏独立配额监控面板」（Gemini 模型、Gemini 4 Argon、Claude & GPT 模型）。
- 深度打通 Google 官方配额核心端点（retrieveUserQuotaSummary），精准提取并实时解析 argon 额度桶：
- Gemini 4 专属 5 小时动态限额（5H）：清晰显示当前剩余可用百分比、高精度进度条与重置倒计时。
- Gemini 4 专属周基础限额（Weekly）：直观展示每周额度池水位与重置周期。
  • 智能识别账号订阅等级与 Gemini 4 额度归属：
- 精准区分 Google 官方渠道的「正价订阅版（PRO）」与「体验专享版（EXP / 体验渠道获取）」。
- 针对正价订阅用户，完整激活并呈现专属的独立 Gemini 4 Argon 额度池；
- 针对体验/活动渠道账号，友好标明「与 Gemini 共享」或「无独立额度」，并在鼠标悬停 Tooltip 中提供详尽的权益说明与指引。
  • 历史配额波动留痕：配额快照服务同步支持 gemini-argon-5h 与 gemini-argon-weekly 历史记录，额度消耗趋势一目了然。
【新增 · 扩展客户端用量监控 (Gemini CLI / StepCode / zcode / dsh)】
- 新增 Gemini CLI 本地聊天会话扫描入库（自动扫描并解析会话 JSON，支持百万级 Token 极速事务批量入库）。
- 新增 StepCode 本地会话扫描，修复 Token 统计口径偏差（精确匹配至输入/输出真实消耗）。
- 新增 zcode 与 dsh 客户端用量监控，修复 dsh 日志时间戳毫秒对齐与时序问题。
- 全客户端扫描与用量数据保留周期从 90 天大幅扩展至 400 天（完整覆盖一年以上历史数据）。
【新增 · 长周期快捷选项与 GitHub / Claude 风格方格热力图】
- 时间范围新增「半年」（180 天）与「一年」（365 天）快捷切换选项。
- 打造 GitHub / Claude 风格的贡献热力方格图（Contribution Heatmap Grid）：
- 7 行（周一至周日）按周严谨纵横排列，自动适配全屏与缩放。
- 顶部智能对齐月份刻度标签，左侧对齐「一 / 三 / 五」星期标识。
- 采用对数刻度（Log10）划分为 5 阶渐变靛紫热力色阶，避免单日突发大流量导致日常活跃度失真。
- 鼠标 Hover 实时 Tooltip 显示当日总用量、入/出 Token 及星期几。
- 点击方格即刻下钻：选中该日后，顶部汇总卡片、供应商下钻、客户端汇总、模型汇总及调用明细全量联动下钻，再次点击取消选择。
  • 智能图表模式：≤ 31 天默认柱状图，> 31 天默认方格热力图；并在卡片右上角提供「柱状图 / 方格图」自由切换按钮与动态自适应图例（圆点 vs 热力阶梯块）。
【新增 · 应用更新多语言展示与弹窗双语切换】
- 更新弹窗（UpdateDialog）支持根据应用当前语言自动匹配并呈现对应语言的更新日志。
- 在更新弹窗的日志标题栏右侧加入 [中文] / [English] 快捷切换胶囊，支持实时无缝对照查看。
- 提供本地离线双语更新日志回退机制，全面消灭界面中的硬编码中文。
【架构优化与工程演进】
- 架构重构：引入 IUsageSource 接口与 UsageSourceRegistry 模块化注册机制，统一规范各客户端用量采集与增量读取。
- 统一 Release 编译与发布输出，清除冗余 Debug 缓存。
